Create COASTAL CROWN REALM: a vast soaring fantasy island with monumental white stone and cobalt-blue gold-trimmed castle towers rising across the upper half, cascading aqueducts and waterfalls, emerald treetop terraces, dense medieval port towns of dozens of tiny red-roofed cottages, bridges, gardens, windmills, ships at docks, farming terraces, forest clusters, seabirds and tiny deer. CRITICAL GAME COMPOSITION: keep a SMALL COMPLETELY EMPTY FLAT GRASS DIAMOND centered at exactly 50% canvas width and 57% canvas height. Its full width is 25% of canvas width and full height is 10% of canvas height; diamond vertices top (50%,52%), right(62.5%,57%), bottom(50%,62%), left(37.5%,57%). No buildings, paths, animals, trees, rocks, water or shadows crossing this little diamond. Blend its grass softly into its surroundings; do not outline it or draw a grid. This is the tiny buildable plot, only about 1.25% of the entire picture. Everything outside this small diamond should feel ENORMOUS and richly occupied. Giant castle towers are several times wider and taller than the whole diamond. The rest of the island is densely populated and landscaped, not a broad empty field. Tall structures must not visually overlap the small empty diamond. Use upper and side territories for castles; bottom third for dense hillside town, ravines, waterfalls, docks, and lush hanging cliffs.
